notes: Wilmar International — Singapore-listed diversified agribusiness (Asia's largest palm + grain + sugar processor / trader). Reports in USD. Segments: Food Products (consumer pack oils, rice, flour, noodles in China/India/Africa); Feed & Industrial Products (oilseeds crush, palm refining, sugar milling, oleochemicals); Plantation & Sugar Milling (~230k ha planted oil palm Indonesia/Malaysia/Africa + Australia sugar). FY = calendar year. Net debt is high but largely working-capital-funded inventory (commodity trading book). FY history sourced from issuer annual reports / earnings releases via wilmar-international.com.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue US$50.5B (+18% YoY), core net profit US$1.53B — record year on COVID consumer-pack demand and palm rally.
FY21: Revenue US$65.8B (+30% YoY) on commodity inflation, core net profit US$1.89B — record. YKA (China subsidiary) listed on Shenzhen ChiNext Oct-2020.
FY22: Revenue US$73.4B all-time high; core net profit US$2.40B record on Russia/Ukraine grain disruption + sugar rally. Highest interim dividend ever (S$0.06).
FY23: Revenue US$67.2B (-9% YoY), core profit US$1.53B (-36% YoY) on oilseeds crush margin compression in China + sugar plant ramp.
FY24: Revenue flat US$67.4B; core profit US$1.17B — weakest in 4 years on China consumer pack volumes + plantation profit drag. Anti-bribery probe Indonesia ongoing.
